identityBinding.bindingSemantics: server-authoritative logical device identity; physical hardware/browser identity is acceptance evidence, not cryptographic hardware attestation
identityBinding.acceptanceScopeNote: QLL-6 plus its dedicated Chrome profile is the primary production Kiosk identity target only; it does not by itself close the full WO-03 browser/device acceptance matrix.

requiredViewportEvidence: Desktop 1440x900 keyboard operation, focus order, dialog focus return, long task wrapping
Tablet landscape 1024x768 touch controls, status wrapping, offline recovery
Tablet portrait 768x1024 current-next stacking and blocking form under soft keyboard
Mobile 390x844 two-column controls, safe-area, 200 percent zoom, screen-reader announcement
Chromium and Safari Web Locks support comparison plus lease fallback
DevTools offline-online, refresh, two tabs, concurrent start, 409 conflict and 202 reviewRequired visible feedback
requiredOnSiteDeviceEvidence: iPad or on-site tablet opens the explicit resourceId Kiosk URL and fails closed when identity is not configured
landscape and portrait rotation, auto-lock recovery, weak network, offline and reconnect
rapid taps and two-tab contention do not create duplicate facts and non-controller tab is read-only
offline start-block-resume-complete replays in strict order
conflict or reviewRequired stays at queue head without automatic rebase or skip
browser-cache clearing removes only local delivery state and does not change server facts

grouped-session presentation must be executed on the real acceptance device/browser against the exact separately bounded isolated grouped fixture environment; it must display all bound tasks without presenting them as one-task labor time
real screen reader, external keyboard, touch target and studio-lighting contrast checks
operator logout, identity expiry and device handoff flow
wo03AcceptanceMatrix.closureRule: REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and PROD-11 formal completion must not be marked complete until every frozen WO-03 viewport and on-site device item is recorded; QLL-6 Chrome evidence is necessary but not sufficient. These items are execution and closure evidence and do not block requesting explicit PROD-11 authorization once true preconditions are satisfied.

groupedSessionEvidencePlan.evidencePurpose: satisfy only the mandatory WO-03 grouped-session browser/device presentation check without creating grouped production scheduling facts
isolationContract: must not mount or copy the production data volume
must not use production Kiosk or role credentials
must not dispatch real DingTalk or other provider notifications
must not mutate production scheduling facts
must bind an exact test endpoint environment database identity device/browser and fixture digest before execution
groupedSessionEvidencePlan.existingRepositoryProof: repository already has a grouped-run file-backed fixture exercised through ScheduleStore and createKioskV2Application; that implementation proof does not replace the required real browser/device run
groupedSessionEvidencePlan.failureRule: absence or drift of the exact isolated grouped fixture environment blocks WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE closure but does not block requesting PROD-11 authorization

/credential/hashBase64.source: scrypt-v1 of the execution generated dedicated Kiosk password using the inserted salt

filePayloadContract.materializationRule: replace both null credential placeholders with the exact generated canonical Base64 values; emit only the exact payload keys above; never copy deployment metadata into the JSON file; validate the final file through loadKioskRuntimeAuthV1 with VIEWER SUBMITTER SCHEDULER and ADMIN credential values supplied only as forbidden comparison inputs before atomic installation

credentialProvisioning.rawPasswordLifecycle: one-time operator-to-device provisioning; if lost, rotate by generating a new credential and config rather than recovering plaintext

databaseWideBriefHostCompatibility.activationRule: fresh-scan every requests_v2.brief_url before PROD-11 authorization/execution; any non-empty brief URL blocks until every observed host is explicitly reviewed and included in allowedBriefHosts

requiredRealDeviceEvidence: browser-cache clearing does not change server facts
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.requiredBeforeProd11Request: a separately authorized production scheduling preparation must create or fresh-confirm one exact canonical requests_v2 acceptance request, STUDIO-PROD-01, an active acceptance scheduling configuration whose businessTimeZone is exactly Asia/Shanghai, one canonical proposal acceptance that derives the acceptance schedule item, and the resulting schedule_item_tasks binding from that item to the exact V2 request
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.canonicalRequestRequirement: the acceptance request must exist in requests_v2 through a bounded canonical materialization path before proposal generation; a V1 snapshot-only request is insufficient
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.canonicalTaskBindingRequirement: the schedule item must be created through canonical proposal acceptance so schedule_item_tasks binds exactly one acceptance request to the single acceptance schedule item; raw SQL insertion is forbidden
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.timeZoneBindingRule: the active acceptance scheduling config businessTimeZone must equal Asia/Shanghai exactly, matching the frozen Kiosk auth payload, before proposal generation and must be revalidated before PROD-11 Kiosk event execution

acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationPacketRule: before PROD-11 may be requested, bind an exact planned acceptanceRunStart and acceptanceRunEnd and fresh-prove the same derived schedule item is confirmed, unused, bound only to the exact canonical V2 acceptance request, and covers the whole planned run window with planned_start <= acceptanceRunStart < acceptanceRunEnd <= planned_end
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationExpiryRule: if current time reaches or passes planned_end before PROD-11 execution starts, or the item becomes used, cancelled, rebound, changed or no longer covers the bound acceptance run window, the authorization packet is stale and PROD-11 must not execute from it
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.executionTimeRecheck: immediately before the first real-device Kiosk acceptance run event, fresh-read the same schedule item, schedule_item_tasks binding and production_runs state and require confirmed status, exact STUDIO-PROD-01, exactly one binding to the frozen V2 acceptance request, zero prior runs, planned_start <= current time < planned_end, and planned_end still covers the bound acceptanceRunEnd
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.failureRule: on any execution-time item, binding, run-state or resource-wide current-selection mismatch stop before the Kiosk run event; PROD-11 does not authorize creating or moving a replacement schedule item. Return to a separately authorized scheduling preparation. If Kiosk runtime configuration has already changed, use the bound configuration rollback without erasing production facts.
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.resourceWideSelectionRecheck: after PROD-11 has enabled the exact Kiosk auth configuration and the device identity has been verified, but immediately before the first run event, perform an authenticated GET /api/v2/kiosk/current?resourceId=STUDIO-PROD-01 and require a successful response whose current.scheduleItemId equals the frozen derived acceptance scheduleItemId exactly
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.selectionConflictRule: any MULTIPLE_CURRENT_CANDIDATES result, any other current scheduleItemId, any other active run exposed as current, a null current item, authentication or identity failure, or any non-success current-read result blocks the run event and forces fail-closed recovery

rollbackContract.beforeAcceptedKioskBusinessFacts: new container may be removed and exact pre-PROD11 container restored if swap/health/identity acceptance fails
rollbackContract.afterAnyAcceptedOrReviewRequiredKioskSub: do not erase business facts; restore pre-PROD11 runtime env without KIOSK_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH, remove Kiosk bind mount, and recreate the service on the PROD11 image with the same volume/port/security topology
